title: Tina, kya pehnogi?
format: Kitty Gang try-on haul on the Shaadi Mein Kya Pehnu game: Tina tries one look per prize group, the gang shoots each down, and the last word flips it

experiment.hook: Tina twirling in her black co-ord on the Shaadi Mein Kya Pehnu home art, heartbeat at 0 s, mascot ball spinning above, chip 'SHAADI MEIN KYA PEHNU? 0/4' pinned from the first frame, she says 'Shaadi kal hai! Pehnu kya?!'
experiment.variable: one protagonist across the whole reel: Tina stays in every frame and changes her outfit colour on every cut (Lehenga, Saree, Clutch, Sandal), with a different friend rejecting each look, instead of a new face every cut, so the viewer follows one person's dilemma to its end
experiment.hypothesis: the 'kya pehnu' panic every viewer has before a wedding this season, with one face to root for, keeps the strong ritual hook of the unboxing (49.4% skip) and holds the middle better than rotating faces: skip under 52%, watched % above 22 (best 21), at least 1 share or tag from 'woh saheli jo kabhi decide nahi karti'

idea: Tina cannot decide what to wear to tomorrow's shaadi: Megha kills the lehenga, Tanya the saree, Shruti the clutch, Avika the heels; Aditi reminds her the shaadi is tomorrow but the Housie is tonight, so Tina plays in pyjamas, calling them limited edition.
beats: hook: shaadi kal, pehnu kya / call: 22 / 1/4 Lehenga: Megha, gol gappe kaise / 2/4 Saree: Tanya, dress code pink / 3/4 Clutch: Shruti, itna kharcha / 4/4 Sandal: Avika, heels mein late / turn: Aditi, Housie aaj hai / ticket / button: Tina in pyjamas, limited edition
caption: Shaadi kal, aur abhi tak decide nahi hua kya pehnu? Us saheli ko tag karo jo har shaadi se pehle yahi karti hai. Aaj {theme} Housie!

lines.text: Itna bhaari? Gol gappe kaise khaogi?
Gold nahi! Dress code pink hai!
lines.say: गोल्ड नहीं! ड्रेस कोड पिंक है!

lines.text: Clutch mein sirf lipstick? Itna kharcha kyun?
lines.say: क्लच में सिर्फ़ लिपस्टिक? इतना खर्चा क्यों?

lines.text: Hmm. Shaadi kal hai. Housie aaj.
lines.say: हम्म। शादी कल है। हाउज़ी आज।

lines.text: Pyjama. It is limited edition, darling.
lines.say: पजामा। इट इज़ लिमिटेड एडिशन, डार्लिंग।
